  • Element Details

    • table

      String table
      Table containing both vector and relational data.

    • vectorColumn

      String vectorColumn
      Column name storing the vector embeddings.
      Default:
      "embedding"

    • metric

      DistanceMetric metric
      Distance metric for similarity comparison.
      Default:
      COSINE

    • limit

      int limit
      Maximum number of results to return.
      Default:
      10

    • queryParam

      String queryParam
      Name of the method parameter holding the query vector (float[]).
      Default:
      "queryVector"

    • filter

      String filter
      SQL WHERE clause for structured filtering (appended after vector search). Supports Spring Expression Language (SpEL) with method parameter references. Example: "category = :category AND active = true"
      Default:
      ""

    • columns

      String[] columns
      Columns to SELECT alongside the distance. Empty = all columns.
      Default:
      {}

    • readOnly

      boolean readOnly
      Run inside a read-only transaction for consistency.
      Default:
      true

    • beamSize

      int beamSize
      Beam size hint for vector search accuracy. 0 = database default.
      Default:
      0

    • maxDistance

      double maxDistance
      Maximum distance threshold — results farther than this are excluded. A value <= 0 disables the threshold.
      Default:
      0.0

    • prefixColumns

      String[] prefixColumns
      Prefix columns for the vector index (CockroachDB v26.2+).

      Prefix columns enable pre-filtering in the vector index itself, avoiding a full scan. They must appear before the vector column in the CREATE VECTOR INDEX statement.

      Example: prefixColumns = {"tenant_id"} generates: 

      CREATE VECTOR INDEX ON table (tenant_id, embedding vector_cosine_ops)
      Default:
      {}
